title: Resolve, one recorded run
sop: KYB onboarding SOP (sop/kyb_sop.md), the approved spec spec/kyb-v1.json and the six example case files

steps.title: Z3 checks the SOP
steps.text: Resolve runs Z3 on the approved spec, version 1, and works out each example case file's outcome from its facts. Z3 finds three problems in the SOP itself. Each one is found for every possible case, not just the six examples.

steps.title: Claude writes the questions
steps.text: For each problem, Claude writes a question for the policy owner in plain words, two options, and the spec edit each option means. Claude only proposes: each edit must load and quote the SOP.

steps.title: Resolve shows what each option would change
steps.text: Before the owner answers, Resolve applies each option's edit and runs Z3 again: does the problem go away, does the edit cause a new one, which kinds of case decide differently (with an example of each), and which past cases flip.

steps.title: The owner answers, and version 2 is written
steps.text: The owner answers two questions and sends them as one batch. Resolve applies exactly the edits the owner was shown, into version 2, unapproved, and checks it again. Cedar Ridge Payments goes from escalate to approve. Z3 finds one new problem, the one the first answer's impact had warned of.

steps.title: Claude writes the question for version 2
steps.text: The new problem gets a question and options the same way.

steps.title: Resolve shows what each option would change
steps.text: Each option's impact on version 2, worked out before the owner answers.

steps.title: The owner answers, and version 3 is written
steps.text: Version 3 is written from the answer. Z3 finds no problems in it.

steps.title: The owner approves version 3
steps.text: The owner approves the version on screen, named by its fingerprint, so an approval can't land on a different edit of the same version. Cedar Ridge's case file still says escalate, because it was made under version 1, so Resolve flags that the rules now give approve until the case is run again.
